Real Uzbek plate OCR test set: labels to spot-check

Internal review page, not for the deck or UI (real plates of private vehicles). 301 crops from the held-out originals of the Roboflow "Uzbek_Plates" set (CC BY 4.0). Crops are shown upright. The bold text is the label used for the accuracy numbers. Labels were pre-labelled by two models (fast-plate-ocr cct-s-v2-global and Qwen3-VL-4B, shown in grey) and verified by Claude (an AI) crop by crop; they are pending human spot-check. Please check at least 20 % (60 crops) and report disagreements.
